author: National Geographic
description:
Thirty-two years ago, a young female is found dead in the desert outside Phoenix, Arizona – her body too badly decomposed to identify. Now, crime scene technician Stephanie Bourgois is joining forces with the DNA Doe Project to find the girl’s name and bring her home. The search takes a surprising twist when a long lost family member is revealed.
